verdict.rationale: Segment documents a suite of privacy tools and a Privacy Portal meant to help organizations comply with GDPR and CCPA and to streamline their response to privacy regulations. That is a thin, glancing match for privacy-request handling. None of the cited docs explicitly describe user deletion or suppression requests, and Consent Management and the workspace-scoped Public API CRUD are adjacent features that earn no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of user deletion/suppression request handling, evidence that requests are forwarded to connected destinations, an API or workflow for submitting and tracking requests, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
